capabilities: assign sequential number prefixes to newly created files and folders
number existing folders and notes via a retroactive numbering command
skip already-numbered items, Untitled placeholders, and vault-root items
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not create folders; it renames newly created files and folders with sequential number prefixes.
problem: Obsidian gives new files and folders no ordering, so maintaining numbered structures requires manual renaming.
summary: Folder numbering plugin that assigns sequential number prefixes to newly created files and folders to keep vault structures ordered.
